posts.headline: Trump Would Support Israeli Strikes on Iran Nuclear Facilities
posts.body: President Trump told Israeli PM Netanyahu he'd support strikes on Iran's ballistic missile program if nuclear negotiations fail. U.S. military and intelligence officials are discussing potential strike options.

posts.headline: Trump Projects 15% US Growth Under New Fed Chair
posts.body: Trump on Fed Chair nominee Kevin Warsh: 'If our new head of the Fed performs capably, U.S. could grow at 15% or more.' Bold growth projection signals administration's economic ambitions.

posts.headline: Warner Bros. Reconsidering Paramount Sale
posts.body: Warner Bros. is reconsidering reopening sale negotiations with Paramount, sources say. This could reshape the media landscape after previous talks stalled. Media consolidation wave may be returning.

posts.headline: Tech: NVDA, Apple, Microsoft, Micron Into Earnings
posts.body: NVIDIA, Apple, Microsoft, Micron leading tech sector into earnings season. AI infrastructure plays continue to see strong institutional interest. Big tech earnings due this week.

posts.headline: Presidents Day: Markets Closed Monday
posts.body: U.S. stock markets closed Monday Feb 16 for Presidents Day. Futures markets open normally. Check pre-market activity Tuesday for the week's directional cues.
